title: Gateway Cold Turn Calibration
objective: Measure settled Gateway process-tree RSS, observed process-tree peak RSS during the first session turn, and time to its first streamed answer on Linux.

phases.title: Provision Gateway Session Env
phases.intent: Create a disposable OpenClaw env without starting the gateway yet so Kova auth is applied before the gateway process boots.

phases.title: Start Gateway
phases.intent: Start the gateway after auth/provider config is already present in the OpenClaw home.

phases.title: Cold Gateway Session Turn
phases.intent: Create the Gateway session, send the first message through `sessions.send`, and verify the final assistant response is present in chat history.
commands: node {kovaRoot}/support/run-gateway-session-send-turn.mjs --env {env} --session-key kova-gateway-session-send --create-session true --min-assistant-count 1 --message 'Reply with exact ASCII text KOVA_AGENT_OK only.' --expected-text KOVA_AGENT_OK --timeout 120000 --observe-answer-delta true
evidence: Gateway process-tree RSS samples during the turn
